description: Closed molecular system for independent computational investigation of aqueous basicity of two PyDIG geometric isomers.

molecules.label: E,E-PyDIG neutral base
molecules.protonation: Neutral PyDIG; the SMILES is a representative guanidine tautomer. Redistribute guanidine N-bound hydrogens and associated bond orders when searching neutral tautomers, preserving formula, heavy-atom connectivity, total charge and both pyridylmethylene E/Z labels.
molecules.stereochemistry: E,E at both pyridylmethylene C=N bonds

molecules.label: E,E-PyDIG singly protonated conjugate acid
molecules.protonation: Singly protonated PyDIG conjugate acid; the [NH2+] notation is a representative guanidinium form. Evaluate chemically valid conformers/tautomers of this charge state and preserve both outer E/Z labels; do not move the extra proton to a pyridine without explicitly investigating a distinct protomer.

tautomer_boundary: The displayed neutral guanidine =NH form is not a fixed sole tautomer. Central =NH and terminal NH2 forms belong to the allowed molecular identity. Select or combine validated conformers/tautomers from calculated solution thermochemistry; no preferred tautomer, geometry or ranking is supplied.
